entities.name: Tacenda
entities.description: A fifteen-year-old Kessig girl whose song of protection fails, who seeks revenge on the Lord of the Manor, kills her sister and becomes the Bog Entity's vessel.

entities.name: Willia
entities.description: Tacenda's twin sister, a fearsome warrior thought dead, who gathers souls for the Bog Entity and is killed by Tacenda.

entities.name: Davriel
entities.description: The manor's lord and consorter with demons who helps Tacenda investigate Verlasen's fall.

entities.name: Davriel's Entity
entities.description: The entity bound to Davriel that confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity.

entities.name: Bog Entity
entities.description: A power hidden in the Bog whose parts are in Tacenda and Willia; it is made whole inside Tacenda.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Soul-draining spirits from the Bog that attack Verlasen and resist Tacenda's song.

entities.name: Seelenstone
entities.description: A stone holding souls that spoke to Willia and was broken to release them for the Bog Entity.

entities.name: Nameless Angel
entities.description: An angel murdered by the Priory's people and later struck by Emrakul's madness, whose soul urged Tacenda to a new song.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi whose madness struck the Nameless Angel.

entities.name: Priory
entities.description: The church-linked priory where Willia served as an acolyte, whose people murdered the Nameless Angel.

entities.name: Verlasen
entities.description: Tacenda and Willia's hometown, protected by them until the Whisperers' attack.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The Innistrad province where the story takes place.

events.summary: Tacenda and Willia are born cursed, one blind by day and the other by night, and grow into protectors of Verlasen.
events.quote: Tacenda would go blind with the rising of the sun, while Willia experienced the same when it became night

events.summary: Just after the girls turn fifteen, their parents are attacked in the woods and killed.
events.quote: their parents were attacked in the woods and killed

events.summary: Willia is allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor.
events.quote: Willia was allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor

events.summary: Geists drain the souls of Verlasen's villagers and Tacenda's Song of Protection fails.
events.quote: Tacenda's Song of Protection failed to ward the geists off

events.summary: Tacenda attacks the Lord of the Manor with a rusty pick; Davriel brushes it off and decides to help her.
events.quote: attempted to kill him with a rusty pick

events.summary: Tacenda and Davriel reason that the Whisperers come from the Bog.
events.quote: Davriel reasoned that they were from the Bog

events.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity, but the Bog is empty and they are besieged by Whisperers.
events.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

events.summary: At the Priory they discover Willia is alive and a major player in the conflict.
events.quote: none other than Tacenda's, thought to be deceased, sister Willia

events.summary: Willia accidentally kills her parents with the stone's power and turns them into Whisperers.
Willia learns the Priory murdered the Nameless Angel and turns to the Bog's power, draining Verlasen's souls.
events.quote: lost her faith when she found out that the people of the Priory had murdered the Nameless Angel

events.summary: Willia breaks the Seelenstone to release its souls to the Bog Entity.
events.quote: she broke it to release its souls for the benefit of the Bog Entity

events.summary: Tacenda finds the Nameless Angel's body, whose soul encourages a new song, and she defeats and absorbs the Whisperers.
events.quote: Tacenda managed to defeat the Whisperers and absorb their souls

events.summary: With Davriel's help Tacenda overcomes and kills Willia, and the Bog Entity is made whole inside Tacenda.
events.quote: she also overcame and killed Willia

events.summary: Tacenda, holding ten thousand souls, releases some and vanishes.

relations.quote: Tacenda and her twin sister Willia
he decided to assist her in figuring out what happened to Verlasen
she also overcame and killed Willia

relations.note: Enthralled by its promises, she gathered souls for it.
